# References and provenance

## CDSeq2

The CDSeq2 manuscript is in preparation. This book accompanies version 16; a final article citation, DOI and software archive DOI have not yet been assigned here. Package authorship and licensing remain as recorded in the package `DESCRIPTION` and `LICENSE` files.

The original CDSeq method is described in Kang K, Meng Q, Shats I, et al. **CDSeq: A novel complete deconvolution method for dissecting heterogeneous samples using gene expression data.** PLoS Computational Biology (2019). [Article](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pcbi.1007510).

## Deconvolution and individual expression

Methods differ in their target outputs. Many focus on cell composition; a smaller group also estimates cell-type expression, including sample-specific profiles. CDSeq2's prioritization component is evaluated as an additional user function, rather than a claim that individual-level inference is unique to CDSeq2.

- Newman AM et al. **Determining cell type abundance and expression from bulk tissues with digital cytometry.** Nature Biotechnology (2019). [CIBERSORTx](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-019-0114-2).
- Wang J, Roeder K, Devlin B. **Bayesian estimation of cell type-specific gene expression with prior derived from single-cell data.** Genome Research (2021). [bMIND](https://doi.org/10.1101/gr.268722.120).
- Chu T, Wang Z, Pe'er D, Danko CG. **Cell type and gene expression deconvolution with BayesPrism enables Bayesian integrative analysis across bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing in oncology.** Nature Cancer (2022). [Article](https://doi.org/10.1038/s43018-022-00356-3); [software documentation](https://github.com/Danko-Lab/BayesPrism).
- Wang X et al. **Bulk tissue cell type deconvolution with multi-subject single-cell expression reference.** Nature Communications (2019). [MuSiC](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-018-08023-x).
- Jew B et al. **Accurate estimation of cell composition in bulk expression through robust integration of single-cell information.** Nature Communications (2020). [Bisque](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-020-15816-6).
- Dong M et al. **SCDC: bulk gene expression deconvolution by multiple single-cell RNA sequencing references.** Briefings in Bioinformatics (2021). [SCDC](https://doi.org/10.1093/bib/bbz166).

## Data and evaluation

- Mathys H et al. **Single-cell atlas reveals correlates of high cognitive function, dementia, and resilience to Alzheimer's disease pathology.** Cell (2023). [Article](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2023.08.039).
- The 1000 Genomes Project Consortium. **A global reference for human genetic variation.** Nature (2015). [Article](https://doi.org/10.1038/nature15393).
- Benjamini Y, Hochberg Y. **Controlling the false discovery rate: a practical and powerful approach to multiple testing.** JRSS B (1995). [Article](https://doi.org/10.1111/j.2517-6161.1995.tb02031.x).
- Morris TP, White IR, Crowther MJ. **Using simulation studies to evaluate statistical methods.** Statistics in Medicine (2019). [Article](https://doi.org/10.1002/sim.8086).

## Documentation and assistance

The website is a [Quarto book](https://quarto.org/docs/books/), with deployment through [GitHub Pages custom workflows](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/getting-started-with-github-pages/using-custom-workflows-with-github-pages). Documentation text, example scripts and figure-presentation code were prepared with OpenAI Codex assistance. Scientific claims refer to the included data and cited methods; authors retain responsibility for review and the final release.

Kai Kang and Kaiyu Xie. CDSeq2 0.1.0: individual-level cell-type expression with gene-type prioritization. Zenodo. [10.5281/zenodo.23489824](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23489824).

[GitHub release](https://github.com/kkang7/CDSeq2/releases/tag/v0.1.0) · [Linux and macOS package validation](https://github.com/kkang7/CDSeq2/actions/runs/39370467686). The archive preserves the tagged software and bundled reproduction materials; current documentation may include later citation and publication-status updates.
